Class RmiClientHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.network.rmi.server.RmiClientHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientConnection, Runnable
public class RmiClientHandler extends Object implements ClientConnection, Runnable
Server-side ClientConnection for one RMI client, wrapping that client's remote VirtualViewRmi stub. Outgoing updates and errors are not sent inline: they are enqueued on a blocking task queue drained by this handler's own thread (it is also Runnable), so that remote callbacks to a single client are serialized and never block the caller.

It also runs a heartbeat that periodically pings the client stub; if a ping fails or times out the client is disconnected. A disconnection (from a failed send or the heartbeat) is reported once to the GameController, which decides whether to abort the game.
